title: Deferred evidence crediting: self-serve attestation escrow and SLA-credit pilot
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Pilot an alternative attestation flow that allows customers to ship contracts faster by submitting a self-serve 'evidence escrow' package and receive a tiered SLA/price credit provisionally. Engineering and Security will perform deferred verification within a bounded window. Goal: reduce legal/sales friction and measure time-to-close, average evidence burden, and security risk delta.
acceptance_criteria: Design and implement a customer-facing attestation submission UI that accepts structured CAIQ snippets and attachments (max 250MB).
Define three credit tiers (Lite/Standard/Assured) with clear eligibility rules and automated provisional credit issuance upon submission.
Backend: evidence escrow store with immutable upload, automatic metadata extraction (question tags, PII flags), and audit log entries for each submission.
Security: a deferred verification runbook that must complete within 14 days; any failed checks trigger automatic credit revocation/notification.
Sales playbook and contract clause drafted and reviewed by Legal to allow provisional credits and post-acceptance remediation terms.
Metric instrumentation: time-to-contract-sign, percent of deals using escrow, credit revocation rate, and NPS delta for onboarding.
